messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's action so that they bow, following the motion demonstrated in the reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated bowing action; do not adopt the reference person's appearance, the reference scene, or the reference camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video, including the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the person's action so that they bow, as shown in the reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action, not the reference person's appearance or the reference scene and camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The woman stands still, then bends forward at the waist to touch the floor with her hand, and finally straightens back up to a standing position.","camera":"The camera maintains a static, medium-long side profile shot of the subject throughout the clip.","clothing":"She wears a blue two-piece outfit consisting of a cropped sports top and matching shorts, along with dark flat shoes.","hair_color":"Her hair appears dark brown or black under the scene's lighting.","hairstyle":"She has long, straight hair that falls past her shoulders.","identity":"A young woman with a slim build is shown in profile, facing right.","scene":"The setting is a futuristic indoor space with a glossy, reflective floor marked with white lines, illuminated by vibrant purple, blue, and pink neon lights and large grid-like window structures."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output replaces the source's raised-arm walking/dancing motion with a standing bow: the woman stands in profile, bends forward at the waist, then straightens back up. The original neon indoor scene, side-profile framing, blue outfit, and overall character appearance are retained.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action to a bow as demonstrated in the reference, while preserving the original person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.
uncertain: Whether the bow's exact depth and timing fully match the reference motion.
unexpected_changes: The bow in the output appears deeper than the reference, with the hand reaching toward the floor, whereas the reference shows a moderate forward bend.
